texts.li: [tinker,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the tinker is back again, pack clanking, and asks {A_nameDef} what has broken since the last visit.
[scholar,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the scholar is back at the gate, still turning over the point {A_nameDef} won last time, and asks for a bed and another try at it.
[doctor,visit3plus] {X_nameDef}, the traveling doctor, is back again, and asks after {A_nameDef} and the others {X_nameDef} saw on the last visit, each of them by name.
[healer,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the healer is back. {A_nameDef} has kept a list of aches and coughs to ask about since the last visit.
[teacher,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the teacher is back at the gate, and {A_nameDef} has a whole season's questions saved up for {X_objective}.
[cook,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the cook is back, and the first thing {X_pronoun} asked at the gate was what the colony has been eating, and whether {A_nameDef} still burns the onions.
[scribe,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the scribe is back with ink on {X_possessive} cuffs and the news of the towns down the road, and wants to see whether {A_nameDef}'s hand has stayed steady.

[teller,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the teller is back. The tales {X_nameDef} left last time are still told at the colony's fire, changed in the telling, and {X_nameDef} wants to hear what the colony has done to them.
[kindred,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} is back, and asked for {A_nameDef} by name at the gate. The two of them still have a conversation from the last visit to finish.
[cool,visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the {TALE} has come back, though the last welcome was a cold one. {X_nameDef} waits at the gate, and asks after {A_nameDef} stiffly, as if unsure of the answer.
[visit2,colony:Open] {X_nameDef}, the {TALE} who came through last season, is back. On the road they say this colony's door is open to travelers, and {X_nameDef} wanted to knock on it again.
[visit2,trait:Kind] {X_nameDef}, the {TALE} who came through last season, is back, and remembers {A_nameDef} as the kindest face at the colony. {X_nameDef} asked after {A_objective} first.

[turning,skill] {X_nameDef} the {TALE} is back, and this time didn't set down the pack at the fire. The road is long, {X_nameDef} told the council, and a trade gets heavy carried from door to door. Would the colony have a {TALE}? Or would {A_nameDef} come along and learn the road?

lines.li: [scholar] By the fire that evening {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} argued a point of learning from both ends, and {A_nameDef} came away knowing more than {A_pronoun} went in with.
[doctor] {X_nameDef} sat with {A_nameDef} by the fire and went through the cases of the road, one by one. {A_nameDef} listened to every one of them.
[healer] {X_nameDef} spent the evening by the fire naming herbs for {A_nameDef}, and saying which ones to leave alone.
[teacher] By the fire, {X_nameDef} gave {A_nameDef} the lesson {X_nameDef} had saved for {A_objective}, and kept at it until the last log burned down.
[cook] {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} talked cooking by the fire all evening. {A_nameDef} has a new way with a stew to try.
[scribe] By the firelight, {X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how to hold a pen so the line doesn't wander, and had {A_objective} practice until it didn't.
[visit3plus] {X_nameDef} took the same seat by the fire as last time, as if it had been kept, and talked with {A_nameDef} until late. {A_nameDef} came away with something learned.
[cool] {X_nameDef} sat stiffly by the fire at first. By the end of the evening the two of them were talking easily again, and {A_nameDef} had learned something.
[friend] {A_nameDef} said it before the council could, and {X_nameDef} set the pack down for good. The {TALE} is one of the colony's now.
[visit3plus] {X_nameDef} took a long breath and asked where {X_pronoun} should sleep. The {TALE} is one of the colony's now.
[friend] {A_nameDef} said goodbye to everyone, and set off down the road beside {X_nameDef} with a light pack and no look back.
[cool] {X_nameDef} didn't argue, and went back down the road the way {X_pronoun} came.
[visit3plus] {X_nameDef} looked surprised, then hitched the pack higher and went on down the road.
[friend] {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to say goodbye to the others, and went on down the road.
